coder_notes: Not a tumour trial: 'GBM' here means gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (HIV PrEP delivery study); not anti-glomerular basement membrane disease either, so coded not_glioblastoma. Descovy (TAF/FTC) split into components; both arms receive it, coded soc_backbone. Crossover trial; the EXPERIMENTAL-labelled standard-of-care arm and ACTIVE_COMPARATOR mHealth arm are both delivery-model arms.
